NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 376 Posts

National Informatics Centre (NIC) has released the official notification for the recruitment of 376 Scientific/Technical Assistant posts. The online application process will begin on 01 September 2026, and the last date to apply is 30 September 2026.

Updated September 01, 2026 10:24 AM

by Banu Officially Verified

The National Informatics Centre (NIC), under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India, has released a detailed advertisement (Ref No. NIC/STA/2026/2) inviting online applications for the post of Scientific/Technical Assistant-A. This is a Group-B S&T (Non-Gazetted) post to be filled purely on the basis of a valid GATE score (2024, 2025, or 2026), with no written examination or interview involved. Online applications can be submitted from 1 September 2026 to 30 September 2026 through the official portal, recruitment.nic.in.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Out

NIC has published the detailed advertisement for the Scientific/Technical Assistant-A post on its official recruitment portal. Candidates are advised to read the complete notification carefully before applying online.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Vacancy 2026

NIC has advertised a total of 376 vacancies (computed from the discipline-wise figures given in the notification) for the Scientific/Technical Assistant-A post, spread across three disciplines: Computer Sciences & Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering, and Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. The notification clarifies that the number of advertised posts is tentative and may increase or decrease at NIC's sole discretion.

S. No. Discipline No. of Posts
1 Computer Sciences & Information Technology 300 (UR-122, SC-45, ST-22, OBC(NCL)-81, EWS-30)
2 Electronics and Communication Engineering 26 (UR-13, SC-3, ST-1, OBC(NCL)-7, EWS-2)
3 Data Science and Artificial Intelligence 50 (UR-22, SC-7, ST-3, OBC(NCL)-13, EWS-5)

In addition to the vertical reservation shown above, horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) is provided: 15 posts in Computer Sciences & IT (Locomotor disability-4, Hard of Hearing-4, Multiple Disabilities-7, including a 3-post PH-MD backlog vacancy within this figure), 2 posts each in Electronics & Communication Engineering and Data Science & AI (Locomotor disability-1, Hard of Hearing-1 in each discipline).

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for the post is assessed as on the closing date, 30 September 2026, and is based on both a valid GATE score and the prescribed educational qualification.

Valid GATE Score Requirement

Discipline GATE Paper Code
Computer Sciences and Information Technology CS
Electronics and Communication Engineering EC
Data Science and Artificial Intelligence DA

Candidates must possess a valid GATE score from 2024, 2025, or 2026 in the paper code corresponding to the discipline they are applying for.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Educational Qualification

  • Computer Sciences & Information Technology: A pass in M.Sc./MS/MCA/B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Electronics & Telecommunication, Computer Sciences, Computer and Networking Security, Software System, Information Technology, or Informatics (single or in combination), along with a valid GATE score in Paper Code CS.
  • Electronics and Communication Engineering: Candidates must possess a valid GATE score in Paper Code EC. The notification does not separately detail the qualifying degree fields for this discipline beyond the GATE requirement.
  • Data Science and Artificial Intelligence: Candidates must possess a valid GATE score in Paper Code DA. The notification does not separately detail the qualifying degree fields for this discipline beyond the GATE requirement.

The candidate must have obtained the essential qualification on or before the closing date. No claim of a qualification equivalent to the prescribed qualification will be entertained. There is no experience requirement for this post.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Age Limit

The upper age limit is calculated as on the closing date, 30 September 2026.

Category Upper Age Limit
UR / EWS 30 years
SC / ST 35 years
OBC (NCL) 33 years
PwBD 40 years (SC/ST PwBD: 45 years; OBC(NCL) PwBD: 43 years)
Service Candidate UR/EWS: 35 years; SC/ST: 40 years; OBC(NCL): 38 years
Ex-servicemen As per Government Rules

An additional 5-year age relaxation applies to candidates serving in Government organizations in the same line or allied cadres, where their existing service is relevant to the advertised post. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL) candidates applies only to posts reserved for them, whereas relaxation for PwBD candidates applies irrespective of reservation status, provided the post is identified as suitable for them.

Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Salary

The Scientific/Technical Assistant-A post carries a pay of Level 6 under the 7th Central Pay Commission, i.e., ₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400 per month, in addition to applicable allowances as per Government of India norms.

Also Read: IOCL Marketing Division NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Application Fee

Category Application Fee
SC / ST / PwBD / Women candidates Nil
UR / OBC (NCL) / EWS ₹800

Candidates applying for more than one discipline must pay ₹800 separately for each discipline applied for. The fee can be paid only through online mode (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking); Cash, Demand Draft, Pay Order, or Cheque will not be accepted. Bank charges towards remittance, if any, must be borne by the candidate. The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Selection Process

  • Only candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria and who have completed registration on the NIC portal will be considered for further selection.
  • A category-wise merit list will be prepared for each discipline based on GATE Score, with equal weightage given to GATE 2024, GATE 2025, and GATE 2026 scores.
  • Candidates must submit their best GATE score from any one of the eligible years for the discipline applied.
  • In case of a tie: (1) the older-year GATE score is ranked higher; (2) if the score and year are the same, the older candidate is ranked higher; (3) if still tied, the candidate with a higher percentage in the essential qualification is ranked higher.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification before being offered a provisional appointment.
  • Non-appearance for document verification with original documents will result in rejection of candidature.
  • Document verification will be conducted at Delhi or any other location/mode approved by the competent authority; no request for postponement or change of location will be entertained, and no TA/DA will be paid.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Documents Required

  • Scanned recent colour photograph (JPEG/JPG, 50 KB–200 KB)
  • Scanned signature in blue or black ink (JPEG/JPG, 10 KB–50 KB)
  • Date of Birth proof (Municipality certificate or Matriculation/High School/SSC Certificate)
  • Matriculation Certificate
  • Senior Secondary Certificate
  • Valid GATE Score Card for 2024/2025/2026
  • Essential Qualification Certificate (M.Sc./MS/MCA/B.E./B.Tech. Pass Certificate) with marksheets
  • CGPA conversion certificate from the University Registrar (if applicable)
  • Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS), if applicable
  • PwBD certificate (minimum 40% permanent disability), if applicable
  • Experience Certificate (if any)
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC), if applicable
  • Age relaxation certificate, if applicable
  • Aadhaar Card (for Aadhaar-based authentication)

All document PDFs must be self-attested scanned copies, sized between 10 KB and 500 KB each.

How to Apply for NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official NIC recruitment portal at https://recruitment.nic.in.
  2. Complete Step 1: Registration using a valid email ID and active mobile number.
  3. Complete Step 2: Fill the online application form and upload all required documents.
  4. Complete Step 3: Pay the application fee online, if applicable to your category.
  5. Complete Step 4: Download the Confirmation Page after successful submission.
  6. Ensure all four steps are completed; an incomplete application will be summarily rejected.
  7. Take a printout of the confirmation page and note the Application ID for future correspondence.

Candidates should fill the online application form carefully, as no change in name, category, address, mobile number, or email ID will be permitted after submission. Aadhaar-based authentication will be used at every stage of the recruitment process.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Important Instructions

  • Applications not in conformity with the requirements of the advertisement are liable to be rejected.
  • Candidates working in Central/State Government, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must furnish a No Objection Certificate confirming no disciplinary/vigilance case is pending or contemplated.
  • Only qualifications obtained through Distance Education/Open University mode recognized by the Distance Education Council (and AICTE, where necessary) will be considered eligible.
  • Furnishing false, tampered, or fabricated information, or suppressing material facts, will lead to rejection/cancellation of candidature at any stage, and may lead to criminal prosecution or debarment from future NIC recruitment.
  • The post carries an All India liability, and the selected candidate may be posted anywhere in India or outside India.
  • No query seeking advice on eligibility or posting location will be entertained.
  • Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be Delhi.
  • For technical issues related to the online application, candidates can email [email protected], mentioning the advertisement number in the subject line.
  • NIC reserves the right to modify, alter, restrict, enlarge, or cancel the recruitment process without prior notice, and its decision will be final.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Recruitment 2026 FAQs

Q1. What is NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Recruitment 2026?

It is a recruitment drive by the National Informatics Centre, under Advertisement No. NIC/STA/2026/2, to fill Group-B S&T posts of Scientific/Technical Assistant-A based on valid GATE scores, across three disciplines.

Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Recruitment 2026?

A total of 376 vacancies (computed from the notification's discipline-wise figures) are available across Computer Sciences & IT (300), Electronics and Communication Engineering (26), and Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (50), subject to increase or decrease.

Q3. What is the last date to apply for NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Recruitment 2026?

What is the last date to apply for NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Recruitment 2026?

Q4. What is the qualification required for NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A?

For Computer Sciences & IT, candidates need M.Sc./MS/MCA/B.E./B.Tech. in specified fields along with a valid GATE score in Paper Code CS. For Electronics and Communication Engineering and Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, a valid GATE score in Paper Code EC or DA respectively is required; the notification does not separately detail the qualifying degree fields for these two disciplines.

Q5. What is the age limit for NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Recruitment 2026?

The age limit is 30 years for UR/EWS, 35 years for SC/ST, and 33 years for OBC(NCL), as on the closing date (30 September 2026), with further relaxation for PwBD, service, and ex-servicemen candidates.

Q6. What is the application fee for NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Recruitment 2026?

The fee is ₹800 for UR/OBC(NCL)/EWS candidates and Nil for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates. Candidates applying for multiple disciplines must pay ₹800 per discipline.

Q7. How can I apply online for NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Recruitment 2026?

Candidates can apply online only through https://recruitment.nic.in by completing registration, filling the application form, uploading documents, paying the fee (if applicable), and downloading the confirmation page.

Q8. What is the selection process for NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A?

Selection is based entirely on a valid GATE score (2024/2025/2026) - there is no written exam or interview. A category-wise merit list is prepared per discipline, followed by document verification and provisional appointment.

Q9. What is the salary for NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A?

The post carries a pay of Level 6 under the 7th CPC, i.e., ₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400 per month.

Q10. Where will NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A selected candidates be posted?

The post carries an All India liability, and the selected candidate may be posted anywhere in India or outside India, in the interest of the organization.
